EmailTemplate.subject: About your certification request
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thanks for your interest in Flywire Security requesting a copy of our security certification. We're committed to making the global payment experience effortless and safe for you and your payers.
If you are a prospect and not yet a Flywire client, please sign and return the Non Disclosure Agreement to security@flywire.com <[[mailto:security@flywire.com]]> and we will process your request and notify your relationship manager as quickly as possible. If you are already a Flywire client, please send an email to security@flywire.com <[[mailto:security@flywire.com]]> requesting the certification on behalf of your organization, and we will review the request and send it to you.
Download NDA <[[https://assets.flywire.com/documents/Flywire-Mutual-NDA-Form.pdf]]>
Thank you, The Flywire Team
